body.statement: Every real semialgebraic set is a finite disjoint union of smooth semialgebraic manifolds satisfying the frontier condition; in particular, every point belongs to a smooth stratum and each stratum is locally Euclidean.

source.verbatim_statement: can be written as a disjoint union of finitely many smooth manifolds

attestation.note: Transcribed from the semialgebraic stratification paragraph on page 8.
